$comment: Stackra file contract: Purpose: the shape of a SERVICE member's runway.yaml: WHAT the member needs per environment. Boundary: shape only; the member is the folder that holds the file, so it has no `member` key; WHERE it runs and how it is packed (groups, `isolate`, cpu, memory, instances, worker splits) is the root runway's topology (runway/root.json) and every root key is refused here; what the service IS is stackra.config.ts, and what it needs that gen can derive is the manifest `infra`. Runtime: node (editors and validators). Governing contract: ADR 0296 (member runway: requires, secrets, environments), ADR 0227 (engines), ADR 0238 (logical databases and pool budgets), ADR 0173 (secret names), ADR 0190 (health), ADR 0294 (config keys).
title: runway.yaml (service member)
description: WHAT one service needs: the dedicated resources it requires beyond the derived ones (each with a reason), the secret NAMES it reads, health thresholds, and per environment its port, the sizes of its own stores and the config values that set its config classes (ADR 0296 decision 1). No secret value, no business value, no placement.

$schema.description: The schema reference `stackra validate` reads (`@stackra/runway/schema/service.json`). Editors use the `# yaml-language-server: $schema=` comment instead.

requires.description: One entry per resource the member needs beyond what gen derives from stackra.manifest.json. A shared resource needs no entry; a dedicated one says why the member cannot share (ADR 0296 decision 1). Engines follow ADR 0227: a deferred or rejected engine is refused, so dedicated search is Postgres.

database.description: A database server of its own instead of a logical database on the shared one (ADR 0238).

search.description: A search store of its own; Postgres hybrid search is the only engine until ADR 0227's revival trigger fires (ADR 0296 decision 5).

cache.description: A cache of its own instead of a keyspace on the shared cluster.

secrets.description: Every @Secret of src/config/*, by NAME; gen fails on a missing one. Values live in Infisical and runway syncs them on deploy (ADR 0173).

health.description: Thresholds only; the path and checks are stackra.config.ts `health` (ADR 0190).

requireMigrations.description: Not ready until every migration has run.

timeoutSeconds.description: Time a readiness check may take.

eventLoopLagMs.description: Event loop lag above which the process counts as stuck.

environments.description: Per-environment values. Names are fixed (ADR 0170 DP5).

port.description: A TCP port. Lanes add N × `portStep` per worktree.

engine.description: The engine of the resource. ADR 0227's deferred and rejected engines are refused.

dedicated.description: The member cannot share this resource; `reason` says why. Off means a shared resource with a named engine.

reason.description: One line on why the member needs the resource to itself; required when `dedicated` is true.
examples: price snapshots and cart sessions need their own eviction policy

queue.description: Size of one queue. Its name comes from the manifest.

visibilityTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a taken message stays hidden before it is retried.

dlq.description: Give the queue a dead-letter queue.

environment.description: One environment of a service member: sizes and values only, never placement.

port.description: The service's own listener when run standalone; under `encore run` the root gateway fronts it.

devConsolePort.description: Port of the service's dev console.

database.description: The member's logical database on the shared server (ADR 0238 d2), one Postgres schema per module inside it (ADR 0294 decision 20).

plan.description: Database plan; `shared` puts every preview on one small server.

extensions.description: Postgres extensions the service needs, from the approved list (ADR 0160).

readReplica.description: Give the service a read replica.

poolBudget.description: Database connections this member may hold on the shared server; the root `defaults.service.database.poolBudget` applies otherwise (ADR 0238).

cache.description: The member's cache: a keyspace on the shared cluster, or the size, replicas and eviction of a dedicated cache it `requires`.

memoryMb.description: Memory of a dedicated cache, in MB.

eviction.description: Eviction policy of a dedicated cache.

buckets.description: Size per bucket the manifest lists, by bucket key.

queues.description: Settings per queue. Names come from the manifest (job queues, listener queues, the notifications queue).

crons.description: Cron schedules from the actions' `job.cron` option.

enabled.description: Run crons. `encore run` does not, so dev turns them off (ADR 0091).

secrets.description: The secret names this environment receives when it is not every name of the top-level `secrets`.

config.description: The last config layer: per-environment values keyed by config key (ADR 0294 decision 20), driver choices included (`queue.driver`, `notifications.driver`, `media.disk`). It overrides the root `defaults.service.config`.

additionalProperties.description: Field values of one config class: literals, `ref:<path>`, or a value gen derives such as `from-member: web` (another member's dev origin, so no port is repeated, ADR 0170).
